course_outline_concepts: Classical filters: DEITA (complexity x quality x diversity), Cherry-LLM and IFD, Superfiltering, AlpaGasus
IFD score math: conditioned / unconditioned perplexity ratio — what it captures and misses
Gradient-based selection: LESS — select training samples whose gradients align with a validation target
Prismatic Synthesis (Jung 2025, Yejin Choi group): G-Vendi = entropy in gradient space; '7B beats 671B generator'
When each filter actually pays vs when it's cargo-culted

sources.what_to_extract: Three-axis framework (complexity x quality x diversity); Evol-Complexity / Evol-Quality scorer training; score-first diversity-aware greedy selection; 6K-10K beats 300K; ablation that removing any axis hurts.
Self-guided IFD selection recipe; warmup on ~1K random samples for 1 epoch; top 5-15% by IFD beats full-set training; released IFD-scored Alpaca/WizardLM.
Exact definition IFD(q,a) = PPL_cond(a|q) / PPL_uncond(a); interpretation across <1, ~1, >1 bands; cherry cluster just below 1; practical forward-pass recipe.
GPT-2 125M IFD rankings transfer to Llama-2-7B (Spearman rho high); ~20x filtering speedup; rank-stability (not IFD magnitude) is what transfers.
ChatGPT 0-5 accuracy+helpfulness rubric; 52K Alpaca -> 9K at threshold 4.5; 5.7x training speedup; threshold sensitivity (4.5 > 4.0 > 3.5).

Influence-function approximation; LoRA warmup + Adam-adjusted gradient + 8K random projection + L2-normalize; cosine similarity to query gradient; 5% LESS >= 100% random on MMLU/BBH/TydiQA; transferability across model size and family.

G-Vendi = exp(von-Neumann entropy of normalized-gradient density matrix); 300+ runs Spearman rho ~0.9 with OOD acc; Prismatic pipeline targets low-density gradient clusters; 7B student beats 671B-distilled baselines.
Tag-space diversity as a pre-gradient baseline; coverage + complexity metric; contrast with gradient-space diversity.
Open-set instruction tagger; tag diversity + tag complexity definitions; predecessor to DEITA's complexity axis.
Superficial Alignment Hypothesis; 1K curated beats 52K; diversity > raw count; response-quality caps model regardless of prompt richness; motivates the whole filter-before-train discipline.

hard_rules: No CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Derive IFD ratio properly (conditional / unconditional PPL)
Derive LESS influence formula properly (Adam-adjusted gradient dot product with target)
Derive G-Vendi properly (von-Neumann entropy of normalized-gradient density matrix)
